run_ccd_sphere_simulation: run the pybullet simulation that drops a grid of spheres onto a terrain mesh with CCD enabled
create_collision_shape_mesh: create a concave trimesh collision shape from a terrain OBJ file with internal edge flags
create_multibody_spheres: create a 5x5x5 grid of sphere multibodies with a small radius for CCD testing
change_dynamics_ccd_radius: change dynamics on a body to set the CCD swept sphere radius for continuous collision detection
set_physics_engine_parameter: set the physics engine parameter to configure allowed CCD penetration distance
